name: cessna-sim
$comment: The flyable Cessna 172P: the c172p airframe with its landing gear on the runway, the power train, the flaps and an optional autopilot, with the FMU interface of the cessna-sim host as export markers. The default run is the demo: takeoff from runway 36, climb and a turn to the east. Generated by design/build_model.py; see the README.

annotations.text: **Airframe.** RigidBody3D at the centre of gravity of the POH gross loading (2400 lb, station 45.6 in), body axes x forward, y left, z up; Jxx, Jyy, Jzz = 2308, 1973, 3702 kg m^2 (the product Jxz 1.7 kg m^2 is neglected). Gravity is inside RigidBody3D.

**Power train (rotational bond graph).** The crankshaft 1-junction: the engine (PistonEngine, a torque source modulated by the throttle, the mixture and the manifold pressure), the crankshaft + propeller inertia (Rotor3D: the axial momentum, spinning about body x, on the airframe through RotorMount, so its torque reaction and gyroscopic moment act on the airframe) and the propeller (an R: torque over the shaft speed and the airspeed). The thrust and the propeller's aerodynamic torque act on the airframe at the hub (PropWrench).

**Landing gear (bond graph per leg).** GearContact is the tyre-runway contact: a modulated transformer from the airframe's multibond (through Mount, at the contact point) to three translational bonds: the runway normal with the strut spring (C) and damper (R) on a 1-junction, the rolling direction with the rolling resistance and the brake (R), and the side direction with the tyre's cornering force (R). The nose wheel steers 10 deg with the pedals; the toe brakes act on the main wheels.

**Inputs.** The ExportInputPass markers pass the demo pilot (or the globals) through in bg-sim; in the FMU the host drives them: yoke, pedals, throttle, mixture, flaps, trim, toe brakes, the autopilot's modes and references, and the wind.

parameters.name: qw0
parameters.description: Start state (set together by design/design.py: the runway start at rest, engine at idle, flaps 10). Pose, body momentum [J w; m v], crankshaft momentum, manifold pressure, alpha filter, flap angle, strut compressions

parameters.name: demo
parameters.description: 1: the demo pilot flies (takeoff, climb, turn); 0: the controls hold the *_hold values

parameters.name: flaps_up_m
parameters.description: Demo: flaps up above this height

parameters.name: ap_roll_mode
parameters.description: Autopilot roll: 0 off, 1 wing leveller, 2 heading hold

options.text: The demo pilot opens the throttle on runway 36, rotates at the **rotation speed**, climbs at 75 KIAS, raises the flaps and turns to the **turn heading**. Change them, add **wind**, or switch the demo off and let the autopilot hold a heading and an altitude.
